# gyro_storage_bucket_object_lock (Resource)

Default retention of a locked bucket on a Gyro Protected Storage service: every new object version is locked for `days` automatically. GOVERNANCE can only be bypassed by Gyro staff on request; COMPLIANCE cannot be shortened or removed by anyone (Gyro included) and needs `acknowledge_compliance = true`. Versions locked under this rule stay locked until their own date even after the rule changes. Destroy only removes the resource from the Terraform state and leaves the rule in place (a warning is shown), unless `disable_on_destroy = true` (then new objects are no longer locked automatically; existing locks are not affected). The bucket must be created with `object_lock = true`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Lock every new object version for 30 days (GOVERNANCE: Gyro staff can bypass it on request).
resource "gyro_storage_bucket_object_lock" "archive" {
  service_id = gyro_storage_bucket.archive.service_id
  bucket     = gyro_storage_bucket.archive.full_name
  mode       = "GOVERNANCE"
  days       = 30
}

# COMPLIANCE: nobody (Gyro included) can delete or shorten the lock until it expires.
# resource "gyro_storage_bucket_object_lock" "audit" {
#   service_id             = 789
#   bucket                 = gyro_storage_bucket.audit.full_name
#   mode                   = "COMPLIANCE"
#   days                   = 365
#   acknowledge_compliance = true
# }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket` (String) Full bucket name (gyro_storage_bucket.<x>.full_name).
- `days` (Number) Retention in days, 1-3650.
- `mode` (String) GOVERNANCE or COMPLIANCE.
- `service_id` (Number) Protected Storage service id.

### Optional

- `acknowledge_compliance` (Boolean) Must be true for mode = COMPLIANCE: you accept that COMPLIANCE-locked versions cannot be deleted by anyone until they expire, the data is kept and the service keeps being billed until then (even after cancellation).
- `disable_on_destroy` (Boolean) Turn the default retention off when the resource is destroyed (default false: destroy only forgets the resource).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import gyro_storage_bucket_object_lock.archive 789/archive-ab12
```
